title: isachne angusta
intro: Isachne angusta, commonly known as the narrow-leaved Isachne or Isachne grass, is a type of grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Isachne angusta include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as asthma, bronchitis, and other respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Isachne angusta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
